components.name: Primary Crystal CTA Button
components.description: Glossy Deep Forest Jade capsule button with 135° bevel rim and emerald caustic glow (48px height).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: linear-gradient(148deg, rgba(22, 166, 124, 0.88) 0%, rgba(14, 114, 84, 0.94) 52%, rgba(9, 86, 63, 0.96) 100%); color: #FFFFFF; box-shadow: var(--glass-btn-primary-shadow, 0 14px 30px -6px rgba(14, 118, 86, 0.48), 0 6px 14px -3px rgba(16, 152, 114, 0.32), inset 0 2px 3px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.58)); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 170ms ease, filter 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1.5px); filter: brightness(1.04); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.975); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand-jade, #0E6B4E); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-vndk-wrap { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; width: 230px; } .ds-vndk-input { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 8px 72px 8px 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.14); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--glass-input-bg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96)); color: var(--text-primary, #0B111A); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px -4px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.11), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 170ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-vndk-input:focus { background: var(--glass-input-focus-bg, #FFFFFF); border-color: var(--brand-jade, #0E6B4E); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--brand-jade-glow, rgba(14, 128, 94, 0.24)); } .ds-vndk-suffix { position: absolute; right: 8px; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--bg-subtle, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06)); pointer-events: none; user-select: none; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--brand-jade-text, #09583F); }

narrative.overview:
PayTrack POS pairs a calm architectural daylight studio with sculpted frosted crystal tiles, purpose-built for a solo Vietnamese online-shop owner working from her phone and desk. In daytime Light Mode, a mid-tone neutral Sunlit Limestone and Pewter Slate studio canvas gives bright frosted white crystal cards immediate 3D lift so product prices, buyer addresses, and debt balances pop cleanly between Zalo and Messenger chats. In evening Dark Mode, the workspace transitions smoothly (280ms) into Lit Brushed Titanium and Deep Graphite so smoked titanium glass tiles and luminous silver bevel rims stay crisp without eye-straining pure #000000 UI grounds.

Across iPhone Safari PWA (375px) and Windows desktop (1280px+), tactile craft serves operational speed: opaque porcelain inputs and solid stepper pills sit inside translucent glass panels for zero-ambiguity legibility, Deep Forest Jade concentrates strictly on primary actions and active navigation, and a unified bottom Floating Glass Dock keeps 100% horizontal viewport open for the 12-column accounting ledger.
keyCharacteristics: Strict 60-30-10 material hierarchy: 60% neutral architectural studio canvas, 30% sculpted multi-tier frosted crystal tiles with 135° specular bevel rims, and <= 10% Deep Forest Jade caustic focal controls and semantic status pills.
Opaque-inside-translucent ergonomics: crisp solid porcelain (Light) and deep slate (Dark) form fields and stepper controls embedded inside frosted crystal containers.
Unified Be Vietnam Pro typography across Vietnamese prose and tabular numerals (tabular-nums), honoring a 16px input floor (no iOS Safari auto-zoom) and a 12px Vietnamese diacritic floor.
Chat-ready light-paper lock on shareable PNG receipts and VietQR cards (.print-surface-light) regardless of active Light/Dark theme.

rules.name: The 60-30-10 Crystal Restraint Rule
rules.body: Hold 60% neutral architectural studio canvas, 30% neutral frosted crystal tiles and opaque controls, and <= 10% Deep Forest Jade or semantic status accents; never flood inactive surfaces or backgrounds with saturated green.

rules.name: The Chat-Ready Light-Paper Lock Rule
rules.body: Receipts and VietQR cards always apply .print-surface-light (porcelain-surface + print-ink, color-scheme: light, backdrop-filter: none) even when Dark Mode is active.

rules.name: The 16px Input & 12px Diacritic Floor Rule
rules.body: Every input, select, and textarea renders at >= 16px (src/app/globals.css, preventing iOS Safari auto-zoom), and no Vietnamese UI, badge, or receipt copy drops below 12px.

rules.name: The Semantic Glass Only Rule
rules.body: All backdrop blur, specular bevel rims, and multi-layer elevation live strictly inside semantic .glass-* utilities in src/app/globals.css with @media (prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce) solid fallbacks; never scatter raw backdrop-blur, shadow-lg, rounded-2xl, or rounded-3xl utility classes in TSX.

dos: Do consume CSS custom properties and .glass-* material utilities from src/app/globals.css so Light (#BCC3CE) and Dark (#161C26) themes switch cleanly in 280ms with reduced-transparency and reduced-motion fallbacks.
Do format every VND amount, profit, debt, quantity, phone, and date with .font-mono-tabular (Be Vietnam Pro + tabular-nums) and maintain >= 44px touch targets and >= 16px form inputs.
Do wrap shareable PNG receipts and VietQR cards in .print-surface-light, and pair every route with layout-matched skeletons and FetchErrorCard retries.
donts: Don't use banned AI-slop (indigo-, purple-, bg-clip-text, Sparkles, animate-bounce, tracking-widest) or scatter raw backdrop-blur, shadow-lg, rounded-2xl, or rounded-3xl utility classes in TSX.
Don't add a fixed desktop left sidebar that compresses the 12-column sales ledger, or add decorative numbered eyebrows and generic marketing filler copy.
Don't use pure #000000 on interactive UI dark grounds or define conflicting color/glass tokens outside src/app/globals.css.
